cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Admit You Need Me
cards.instruction: Make someone admit that they need your help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No need to put me in charge. That flat-pack cupboard's leaning. I could take a look.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm merely helping this reach the right outcome. Wonderful. Which page explains that leftover door?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you hold it for a second?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Just to clarify: you're asking for my help?

mechanism: A disclaims taking over the cupboard assembly while controlling its next step and withholding a useful pair of hands until B names the need.
confusable: Not generic helpfulness or overt command status: modest self-presentation contrasts with A deciding when assembly can proceed.
comparison: Needed manual assistance versus needed access to heater controls.
